content.text: Where to Watch Reviews Cast & Crew Episodes Photos Media Info Netflix Watch Trust Me: The False Prophet — Season 1 with a subscription on Netflix. Archi Sengupta LeisureByte.com 23h It’s a harrowing and truly terrifying watch that will make your skin crawl. Go to Full Review Stephanie Morgan Common Sense Media 1d This is a gripping, urgent docuseries that balances shocking revelations with deep authenticity. Go to Full Review Joel Keller Decider 2d The docuseries refreshingly doesn’t pass any judgement on the FLDS community, especially the people who followed Bateman. Go to Full Review Carla Hay Culture Mix Apr 8 This riveting investigative docuseries uncovers disturbing information about a fundamentalist American cult and its twisted leader, who used religion to commit heinous sex crimes. The documentary is courageous advocacy for the survivors. Go to Full Review Karina Adelgaard Heaven of Horror Apr 8 TRUST ME: THE FALSE PROPHET on Netflix is a true crime docuseries with four powerful episodes. It will (and should) anger you to watch this play out. Go to Full Review Read all reviews Walt S @RT36330541 3h A suberb documentary with all the drama of an emotional and tense movie. But it is real. Wonderfully put together and presented. Definitely worth a watch. See more Lucy G. @Lucgle 2d Such a great documentary. Doesn’t put negative light on FDLS women and shows how empowered and strong they can be. This is a much watch See more Stan H @RT96418365 2d This a great documentary. Must see, imo. In addition to the central story, which is riveting, you have intrigue, undercover work, a documentarian with a mission to help those suffering from the same trauma she experienced. Can't praise it highly enough. See more Brian R. @brockwell44 3d Fascinating and deeply disturbing documentary. Young S. @YoungStevie 3d It’s a fascinating and deeply disturbing documentary that capture some dark secrets. The only caveat is to always be skeptical of documentaries, especially Netflix documentaries because we know from experience that they’re often one-sided and they leave out critical information. We don’t know what if anything is being left out or presented to advance a particular narrative. Worth watching. See more Sally H. @RT59440152 3d A beautiful example of hope and love. No judgement and real kindness changes the lives of people.
